standard.summary: 损失长期不下降时自动停止训练，避免过拟合或无效训练浪费时间。
standard.effect: 若在 ac_early_stopping_patience 次评估窗口内 loss 改善小于 ac_early_stopping_threshold，则自动停止训练。
standard.whenToUse: 长步数训练或不确定最佳步数时开启。可防止过拟合继续。
standard.avoidWhen: loss 曲线有明显振荡但整体在下降时，早停可能误判平台期。

standard_en.summary: Stops training automatically when the loss has stopped falling for a long time, so you do not spend hours overfitting or burning steps for nothing.
standard_en.effect: If the loss improves by less than ac_early_stopping_threshold across ac_early_stopping_patience evaluation windows, training stops on its own.
standard_en.whenToUse: On long runs, or when you are not sure what the right step count is. It keeps overfitting from continuing.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When the loss curve oscillates visibly while still trending down -- early stopping may read that as a plateau.

advanced.principle: 维护最近 ac_early_stopping_patience 个评估窗口的 best loss，若当前 best 相比历史 best 改善 < threshold，触发停止。
advanced.tradeoffs: patience 设置过小（<3）容易误触发；过大（>20）则失去保护意义。

advanced_en.principle: Tracks the best loss across the last ac_early_stopping_patience evaluation windows; if the current best improves on the historical best by less than threshold, triggers a stop.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Patience too small (<3) false-triggers easily; too large (>20) loses the protective value.
